import sys

def main():
    dna = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    result = 0
    
    if not dna:
        print(0)
        return
    
    chars = list(dna)
    i = 0
    
    while i < len(chars):
        c = chars[i]
        j = i
        while j < len(chars) and chars[j] == c:
            j += 1
        
        run = j - i
        if run % 2 == 0:
            result += 1
        
        i = j
    
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
